sections.text: Dónal Lunny, a prominent multi-instrumentalist, arranger and producer in Irish traditional music, died of cancer at the age of 79. sections.text: Lunny played a vital role in shaping traditional Irish music by developing new harmonic and rhythmic structures and forming highly influential groups.
